text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's so frustrating! I couldn't... I 
couldn't return everyone's love...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Even though everyone cheered for me so 
hard... I really, truly wanted to win...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I can't stay like this... I have to work 
much harder!

love right back...!"
